pt.noteBody: Código, automação e coordenação de mentoria na PUC Minas.

en.intro: I study Software Engineering at PUC Minas. I build applications in Python and Java. I like turning repetitive tasks into systems that work.
en.noteBody: Code, automation and mentoring coordination at PUC Minas.
en.aboutBody: I learn in the classroom and through projects. In PUC Minas' mentoring program I coordinate volunteers and built Padrinho Track to support new students. I also study APIs, databases and applied AI.
en.skillsNote: Marked where I used it in each project.
en.featuredBody: Padrinho Track came out of the mentoring program's routine. It brings attendance, meetings, reports and certificates into one place.
en.projectsIntro: Academic projects and applications for real problems. The featured one comes first, then the rest from oldest to newest.
en.experienceIntro: Academic coordination, software development and open source.
